name: a status check on any attempt of a paid reference answers the attempt that paid it
note: Exercise the real repository and request handler. Commit attempt 6e..6e for order-golden-settled first (Lightning, created_at 870, expires_at 1030, so it is not reusable at clock 1000), then the settled-golden attempt 7f..7f (which supersedes it), settle 7f..7f at 950, then preclaim the gate; wallet I/O must not occur. 6e..6e stays pending (superseded rows stay pending until a scan closes them). A swap deposit screen polls its own attempt; `paid` is how it learns the order was paid by Lightning.
